description.value:
Drawing from superstitions about scaring a devil by threatening to nail horseshoes to their hooves, you conjure a silver horseshoe over an entrance. A fiend that passes through the target takes 2d6 spirit damage and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The fiend is unaffected.

Success The fiend takes half damage, and attacks against the fiend are treated as magical silver for 1 round.

Failure The fiend takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute. Attacks against the fiend are treated as magical silver for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The fiend takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute. Attacks against the fiend are treated as magical silver for 10 minutes.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
